title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
content: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
content: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
content: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
content: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans
content: The bitcoin miner is taking on borrowing tied to an Ohio power plant as it shifts more of its business toward AI infrastructure.

title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
content: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
content: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
content: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
content: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
content: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
content: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
content: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
content: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.

title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
content: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.

title: Bitcoin Tanks Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO. Should We Really Blame AI?
content: Bitcoin slid toward $63,000 as Anthropic prepared its blockbuster debut. Analysts dispute whether the IPO is draining crypto liquidity, pointing instead to ETF outflows, forced selling and rising interest rates.

title: Saifedean Ammous: AI Could Be “Massively Overvalued” as Bitcoin Starts “Its Own Run”
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Saifedean Ammous: AI Could Be “Massively Overvalued” as Bitcoin Starts “Its Own Run” Saifedean Ammous, author of The Bitcoin Standard, joins BMTV to talk about the AI boom and where Bitcoin goes from here. title: Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft
content: Bitcoin Magazine Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft A Scottish hacker tied to Scattered Spider was sentenced to six years in U.S. prison for a SIM-swap and phishing scheme that stole at least $11.6 million in crypto. This post Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds
content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds Binance says it has a court order from Abu Dhabi Global Market to recover crypto frozen after the $6.3 billion hack. This post Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’
content: Bitcoin Magazine Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’ K33 Research said bitcoin is in "deep value territory" after a 14% weekly drop, as ETF outflows, liquidations and hedging demand reach levels seen near past bottoms. This post Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’ first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout
content: Bitcoin Magazine Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout Ionic Digital sold about 737 bitcoin for roughly $61.6 million after Sept. 30 and plans to use the cash to develop its data center sites, its latest quarterly report shows. This post Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
